explanation: Controlled body 1 converges essentially exactly onto its waypoint by step 1119 (position matches waypoint to ~1e-15, speed ~3.7e-13). On the next update the controller's waypoint-relative direction requires dividing by distance-to-waypoint ~0, producing 0/0 NaN that contaminates body 1 position/velocity and energy. The NaN then corrupts shared step computation, teleporting uninvolved body 0 from x~17.79 to x~14.17 in one dt despite finite velocity. Disabling only the controller removes the failure.
vision_note: For steps 1117-1119 a red body sits motionless on the left while a blue body on the right drifts slightly left toward the central wall. At step 1120 the red body vanishes leaving only a green waypoint cross at its position, while the blue body abruptly jumps leftward to next to the wall.
